title_zh: 蔡健雅：新加坡创作歌手的温柔代表
title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (19/20): Tanya Chua, the Gentle Voice of Singaporean Songwriting
note_en: 虽然…但是… means "although…, (still)…": 虽然她的音乐风格不算最流行，但是很多人认为她是…最好的创作歌手之一. Unlike English, where "although" and "but" can't appear together, Chinese normally uses both halves of the pair. The text also shows the shorter 虽然…但… (虽然蔡健雅来自新加坡，但出道以后…) and the more formal 尽管 "despite" (尽管商业曝光相对较少).
